verdict.rationale: Greptile automatically reviews every pull request, and users can configure review triggers and PR filters (including via greptile.json), so they control when its automated review fires on PR events. It is not a general event-to-action rules engine: the only action is a code review, and Greptile's "custom rules" are review standards rather than event triggers. Missing for 10: a general rules engine mapping arbitrary events to arbitrary actions, documented trigger conditions and syntax, user-definable actions beyond running a review, independent corroboration.
